senses.definition: Free to meet someone, speak on the telephone, enter a romantic relationship, or the like.
examples: I have a question for you when you're available.
Hi, this is Mark Smith calling. Is your mother available?
I asked her if she was available, but she said she had a boyfriend.

senses.definition: A salutation.
An Ave Maria.
A reverential salutation.
A broad street, especially one bordered by trees or, in cities laid out in a grid pattern, one that is on a particular side of the city or that runs in a particular direction.
A way or opening for entrance into a place; a passage by which a place may be reached; a way of approach or of exit.
The principal walk or approach to a house which is withdrawn from the road, especially, such approach bordered on each side by trees; any broad passageway thus bordered.
A method or means by which something may be accomplished.
examples: There are several avenues by which we can approach this problem.
As avenues to foreign influence in innumerable ways, such attachments are particularly alarming to the truly enlightened and independent Patriot.

senses.definition: Any measure of central tendency, especially any mean, the median, or the mode.
examples: You need to show some averages in an executive summary, show some samples of raw data in the document body, and move the full raw data to an appendix.

senses.definition: The arithmetic mean.
examples: The average of 10, 20 and 24 is (10 + 20 + 24)/3 = 18.

senses.definition: A financial loss due to damage to transported goods; compensation for damage or loss.
An indication of a player's ability calculated from his scoring record, etc.
examples: Batting average.

senses.definition: The art or science of making and flying aircraft.
Flying, operating, or operation of aircraft.
examples: The history of aviation is full of daring pioneers.
He works in the aviation industry as a pilot.
Military aviation played a crucial role in the war.

senses.definition: Industry that produces aircraft.
Aircraft.
To try not to meet or communicate with (a person); to shun.
To stay out of the way of (something harmful).
examples: I avoided the slap easily.
One town was flooded from the storm, while the other town avoided the storm.

senses.definition: To keep away from; to keep clear of; to stay away from.
examples: I try to avoid the company of gamblers.

senses.definition: To try not to do something or to have something happen.
Avoidance.
Not asleep; conscious.
examples: We've lain awake a good many nights worrying about her.

senses.definition: Alert, aware.
examples: They were awake to the possibility of a decline in sales.

senses.definition: To become conscious after having slept.
To cause (somebody) to stop sleeping.
A judgment, sentence, or final decision. Specifically: The decision of arbitrators in a case submitted.
The paper containing the decision of arbitrators; that which is warded.
Funding that has been granted for the conduct of a research project.
A trophy or medal; something that denotes an accomplishment, especially in a competition. A prize or honor based on merit.
Vigilant or on one's guard against danger or difficulty.
examples: Stay aware! Don't let your guard down.

senses.definition: Conscious or having knowledge of something; awake.
examples: Are you aware of what is being said about you?
Gotta get going. I wasn’t aware that it was already so late.

senses.definition: The state or level of consciousness where sense data can be confirmed by an observer.
examples: I gradually passed from sleep to full awareness.

senses.definition: The state or quality of being aware of something.
examples: Raise awareness of a topic.
The awareness of one type of idea naturally fosters an awareness of another idea.

senses.definition: From a place, hence.
examples: He went away on vacation.

senses.definition: Aside; off; in another direction.
examples: I tried to approach him, but he turned away.

senses.definition: Aside, so as to discard something.
examples: Throw away, chuck away, toss away.

senses.definition: At a stated distance in time or space.
examples: Christmas is only two weeks away.

senses.definition: Causing awe or terror; inspiring wonder or excitement.
examples: The waterfall in the middle of the rainforest was an awesome sight.
The tsunami was awesome in its destructive power.

senses.definition: Excellent, exciting, remarkable.
examples: That was awesome!
Awesome, dude!

senses.definition: A person who is awesome.
Very bad.
examples: The smell of my socks is awful.
We saw such an awful film last night that we left the theater before the end.

senses.definition: Exceedingly great; usually applied intensively.
examples: I have learnt an awful amount today.

senses.definition: Prone to a particular temptation.
Awfully; dreadfully; terribly.
Lacking dexterity in the use of the hands or of tools.
examples: John was awkward at performing the trick. He'll have to practice to improve.

senses.definition: Not easily managed; embarrassing.
examples: That was an extremely awkward moment. Everyone was watching.
An awkward silence had fallen.
Things got awkward when my boss tried a cheesy pick-up line on me.

senses.definition: Lacking social skills, or uncomfortable with social interaction.
examples: I'm very awkward at parties.

senses.definition: Perverse; adverse; difficult to handle.
examples: He's a right awkward chap.
These cabinets are going to be very awkward when we move.

senses.definition: An imaginary line around which an object spins (an axis of rotation) or is symmetrically arranged (an axis of symmetry).
examples: The Earth rotates once a day on its axis.

senses.definition: A fixed one-dimensional figure, such as a line or arc, with an origin and orientation and such that its points are in one-to-one correspondence with a set of numbers; an axis forms part of the basis of a space or is used to position and locate data in a graph (a coordinate axis).
The second cervical vertebra of the spine.
An imaginary, visualized plane separating two morphologically similar parts of an organism.
